label: prop:phi-q-tower-algebraic-stratification
title: Algebraic stratification of the Φ$_q$ tower in $H_n(R, q)$ (no 3-manifold language)
html:
Proposition. Algebraic stratification of the Φ_q tower in H_n(R, q) (no 3-manifold language)

Superseded. The scalar substrate density \rho_q = 1/\hbar_q^2 used below is the structurally-wrong leading-order ansatz; the operator-valued form supersedes it (mass-endomorphism-tower).

Proposition (algebraic stratification of the \Phi_q tower). Let \beta \in B_n be a braid. The \Phi_q-tower admits a purely algebraic stratification by |S| within the Gröbner-Shirshov filtration of the Hecke algebra:

  \mathfrak{m}(\varrho)
  \;=\;
  \bigl\| \mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta_\emptyset))\bigr\|_F
  \;+\;
  \sum_{|S| = 1} \Phi_q\bigl(\|\hat V_S\|_F\bigr)
  \;+\;
  \sum_{|S| = 2} z^{2} \Phi_q\bigl(\|\hat V_S\|_F\bigr).

The Frobenius norm \|\cdot\|_F evaluates entirely within the ground ring \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}]. This unconditional stratification identifies exactly with the J^{|S|}/J^{|S|+1} grading of the GS confinement filtration.

The algebraic stratification operates strictly pre-\tau. It decomposes the mass endomorphism using only discrete categorical data, isolating the structural descent without invoking any hyperbolic or continuous geometry.
